name: How long does kitchen flooring installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen flooring installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen flooring installation generally takes between one and four days, depending on the material selected and the square footage. Luxury vinyl plank or click-lock laminate installs fastest, often finishing in one to two days. Porcelain tile, natural stone, or marble flooring takes longer—typically three to four days—because it requires subfloor preparation, mortar curing, and subsequent grouting and sealing. Timelines can also expand if existing damaged flooring requires extensive tear-out, if the subfloor needs structural leveling, or if baseboards and molding require custom refitting. For kitchens undergoing full remodels, flooring is usually scheduled alongside cabinet and appliance work to streamline project sequencing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen flooring installations take between one and four days. Floating vinyl plank installs in one to two days, while custom tile and marble work typically takes three to four days.
